content.bridge_context: Studying the atmosphere and the gases that support life.

units.title: Composition of Air
units.explanation: Nitrogen (78%), Oxygen (21%), Argon (0.93%), CO2 (0.03%), and others.
units.dual_language_instruction: Which gas is used by plants for food? / पौधे भोजन के लिए किस गैस का उपयोग करते हैं?

units.title: Layers of Atmosphere
units.dual_language_instruction: In which layer do we live? / हम किस परत में रहते हैं?
